It is collected using ViVO X200 Ultra equipped

However, such zoom introduces severe misalignment that

designed for moderate ×2 to ×4 zoom. To address this,
we design a Cascade Coarse-to-fine Alignment pipeline

each low-quality image is sequentially aligned to its next
higher-focal neighbor using optimization-based registration
or feature-based extractors [22, 29], then refined against the
200 mm ground truth. Finally, we manually filter or realign
problematic cases to ensure precise alignment.
